# Player

**Tags:** `player`

The account that connects to a server. It owns who the person is (friend code, settings, the admin flag, the character played last) and a list of characters (CharacterRoster); all progress in the world is the character's (PlayerCharacter).

> **Goal:** Separate who connects from who walks the world, so one person can keep several characters

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `friendCode` | string | yes | The code a friend types to join this player's world |
| `settings` | json | yes | Client settings (sound, graphics, language, tutorial); kept on this player's machine |
| `admin` | boolean | yes | Whether the host lets this player use admin commands |
| `lastCharacter` | string | yes | Id of the character this player entered last, offered first in the list |
